art226_explained.drafter:
1. That the Petitioner, Rakesh Verma, is the defendant in Title Suit No. 118/2025 pending before the Civil Judge (Senior Division), Patna.

2. That the said Court proceeded ex parte against the Petitioner, who says that summons were never served on him.

3. That by the impugned order dated 4 September 2026 the said Court rejected the application of the Petitioner to set aside the ex parte order. The impugned order is an interlocutory judicial order of a civil court.

4. That a writ of certiorari under Article 226 of the Constitution of India does not lie against a judicial order of a civil court; the route is Article 227, and this petition is made accordingly.

5. PRAYER: It is respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to invoke its supervisory jurisdiction under Article 227 of the Constitution of India, call for the record of Title Suit No. 118/2025, and set aside the impugned order dated 4 September 2026.
